resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Place a clearly visible strip of background above her entire hairstyle, and keep her complete crown, face, and both eyes clearly readable. The second background direction is the measured axis. Keep the complete subject large enough to read while its foreground, middle-distance, horizon, and atmosphere remain visibly separated. One adult full-length editorial photograph: the entire backdrop coated in black ink with giant peeled white patches; one simple material backdrop and broad empty space; restrained slate, clay, sage, and limestone; calm open spacing, no extra props, thin haze; knife-hard silhouette and sharply separated cast shadow. Keep one human only, realistic skin, coherent hands, believable fabric, natural proportions, cinematic depth, and no text, logos, or watermarks. Cover most of the wall with one floor-to-ceiling torn black-and-white ink mural. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult subject stands in a modern library reading room with tall shelves, warm wood, and broad clear aisles, with an asymmetric open side that provides generous space in the direction of the gaze, crisp high-visibility depth with controlled contrast and no distracting glare, and natural green and earth relationships balanced by desaturated structural colors. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery. Final camera lock—use an eye-level mid-thigh inspection frame with the lower edge visibly intersecting both thighs and the complete crown, both eyes, shoulders, and visible hand gestures inside while the knees, calves, shoes, and feet continue beyond the canvas.
